cli.help.context:
Usage: {command} context <page…> [--budget <tokens>] [--update] [--translate <lang>]

Writes {work}/context/<page>.md, the only reading an agent needs to write or update a page: its dependencies (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.10) instead of the whole code inventory and table of contents. A page not written yet is accepted (the context serves to write it); an unknown page is refused.

Arguments and options
  page…                    one or more page ids of content/toc.json
  --budget <tokens>        maximum size of each context, roughly estimated (default: the page template's, 24000 for a feature sheet, else 16000)
  --update                 also includes the page's entry of the last sync report, its diff and its before/after capture sheets (needs {work}/sync-report.json)
  --translate <lang>       the translator's dossier of that page instead (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.12), in {work}/context/<page>.<lang>.md; exclusive with --update
cli.context.missingPage: at least one page id is expected
